section_summary: This section contains patent and technology licensing agreements involving Japanese fertilizer, chemical, recording, radio, and television companies. It includes two brief patent reports and agreements covering Ammophos, synthetic methanol, gramophone records, broadcast receivers, and the Fauser ammonia process. The final Fauser agreement continues beyond page 400.

subfiles.title: Patent license agreement concerning shipboard appliances
subfiles.about: Concludes a Japanese patent license governing royalties, improvements, infringement, accounting, termination, and arbitration.
subfiles.summary: The surviving clauses set interest and cancellation terms for unpaid royalties, require exchange of improvements and reporting of manufacture and sales, and address patent protection and infringement. They also provide for inspection, marking of appliances, termination, and arbitration in London.

subfiles.title: Report on Kunst­dünger patent licenses
subfiles.about: Lists five patents licensed to Nippon Chisso and states that the licenses had not been used since December 1941.
subfiles.summary: Lists patent numbers, owner, licensee, registration date, and lack of use or payment since 1941.

subfiles.title: Agreement between Kunst­dünger-Patent-Verwertungs A.G. and Nippon Chisso
subfiles.to: Nippon Chisso Hiryo Kabushiki Kaisha, Ltd.
subfiles.about: Assigns Japanese patent applications and grants reciprocal manufacturing and sales rights for Ammophos.
subfiles.summary: The agreement supplements a 1928 contract, assigns patent applications to Nippon Chisso, and sets manufacturing, sales, and import rights for Ammophos. Nippon Chisso agrees to pay $140,000 in installments through 1932. A schedule identifies related Swedish, British, French, and Japanese applications.

subfiles.title: Report on SIRI patent licenses
subfiles.about: Lists eight SIRI patents registered to Nippon Chisso and reports no use or payment since December 1941.
subfiles.summary: Lists patent numbers, owner, licensee, registration date, and lack of use or payment since 1941.

subfiles.title: Synthetic methanol license between Ammonia Casale and Nippon Chisso
subfiles.from: Ammonia Casale S.A., as exclusive agent of SIRI
subfiles.about: Grants exclusive Japanese and Chinese rights to SIRI synthetic methanol processes and equipment.
subfiles.summary: The contract identifies Casale and SIRI patents and grants Nippon Chisso process and production rights in Japan and China. It sets fixed premiums, production royalties, technical guarantees, assistance, confidentiality, and obligations to protect patents. The final clauses govern duration, succession, and arbitration; the document gives signing dates in Lugano and Osaka.

subfiles.title: Gramophone & Record Agreement
subfiles.from: Electric & Musical Industries, Ltd. and Columbia Graphophone Co., Ltd.
subfiles.about: Sets territorial, patent, recording, royalty, and supply terms for gramophones and records.
subfiles.summary: The agreement replaces unperformed provisions of a 1928 contract and allocates sales territories in Japan, the Kwantung Leased Territory, and Manchukuo. It exchanges patent licenses, matrices, equipment, and technical information, with detailed pressing fees and royalties. Further clauses govern trademarks, accounts, artists’ and copyright obligations, termination, and English law.

subfiles.title: Radio & Television Agreement
subfiles.about: Licenses radio and television receiver technology for Japan, the Kwantung Leased Territory, and Manchukuo.
subfiles.summary: EMI grants territorial patent and technical information rights, while Nipponophone grants or offers rights in its improvements outside that territory. The agreement covers patent filings, confidentiality, engineering assistance, a ¥3 million payment, monthly royalties, sublicensing, audit rights, termination, arbitration, and English law.

subfiles.title: Supplemental agreement transferring radio and television rights
subfiles.from: Electric & Musical Industries, Ltd.; Nippon Industrial Company, Ltd.; Nipponophone Company, Ltd.
subfiles.to: Columbia Graphophone Company of Japan, Ltd.
subfiles.about: Transfers Nipponophone’s rights under the radio and television agreement to Columbia Japan with guarantees.
subfiles.summary: Transfers license rights to Columbia Japan while retaining Nipponophone’s liability and adding joint guarantees.

subfiles.title: Agreement for use of the Fauser process in Japan
subfiles.from: Società Generale per l’Industria Mineraria ed Agricola (Montecatini Company)
subfiles.about: Licenses the Fauser process for hydrogen, ammonia, and fertilizer production in Japan and Manchuria.
subfiles.summary: The agreement grants process and patent rights, requires plans and technical assistance, and governs exchange of improvements, plant construction, exclusivity, exports, and payments through 1940. Its first schedule sets capital payments and royalties for Dai Nippon’s plant. The second schedule begins terms for a jointly owned company and continues beyond this section.
